title: CrossEnv: Synthesizing Verifiable Cross-Environment Tasks for Long-Horizon Agent Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.22777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Executable synthetic environments provide scalable training tasks and verifiable feedback for long-horizon agents. Existing environment synthesis methods primarily generate tasks within individual environments. However, these tasks do not adequately capture real-world interactions across services, where actions in one service depend on information obtained from another. Synthesizing such tasks is challenging because data generated across environments must remain consistent to support executable and verifiable interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce CrossEnv, a framework that uses an entity-tool graph to identify connections between environments and aligns task-specific data to synthesize executable, verifiable cross-environment tasks. We further propose CrossEnv-Curriculum, which progresses from single-environment tool use to coordination across more environments and business domains, before introducing user interaction. Ac

translated_title: CrossEnv：为长程智能体训练合成可验证的跨环境任务
translated_abstract: 可执行的合成环境为长程智能体提供了可扩展的训练任务和可验证的反馈。现有的环境合成方法主要在单个环境内生成任务，然而这些任务无法充分捕捉真实世界中跨服务的交互场景，即一个服务中的操作依赖于从另一个服务获取的信息。合成此类任务极具挑战性，因为跨环境生成的数据必须保持一致性，才能支持可执行且可验证的交互。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CrossEnv，该框架利用实体-工具图识别环境之间的连接，并对齐任务特定数据，从而合成可执行、可验证的跨环境任务。我们进一步提出了CrossEnv-Curriculum，它从单环境工具使用逐步过渡到跨更多环境和业务领域的协调，最后再引入用户交互。
tldr: CrossEnv框架通过实体-工具图识别环境间连接并对齐任务数据，合成可执行、可验证的跨环境训练任务，并借助课程式训练方法让长程智能体从单环境工具使用逐步进阶到多环境协调。
en_tdlr: CrossEnv synthesizes executable and verifiable cross-environment tasks by using an entity-tool graph to identify inter-environment connections and align task-specific data, paired with a curriculum that progressively trains long-horizon agents from single-environment tool use to multi-environment coordination.
